rows.grounds: root bhaj, present active third singular

items.question: What does the mother worship through devotion arising from your foot-lotus?
premises: The object is implied by context.
items.inference: The verse presents maternal worship mediated by foot-lotus devotion.
uncertainties: The direct object of bhajati is not stated in these three tokens.
items.plain_english: The mother worships by devotion arising from your foot-lotus.
